lines.text: Elihu says the ear tests words as the mouth tastes food, and that Job has declared he is righteous.
Elihu says Job keeps company with evildoers and has said a man gains nothing from delighting in riches.
Elihu says God repays a man according to his deeds and does not act wickedly or pervert justice.
Elihu says God does not favor the rich over the poor, and workers of iniquity can hide in deep darkness.

wrong_details.true: There is no darkness or deep shadow where the workers of iniquity can hide

lines.text: Elihu says Job speaks without knowledge and multiplies his words against God.
